decisions.decision: Drop Location Wealth, Food Productivity, Sailors
decisions.why: No genuine per-location save field exists for any of the three, confirmed by exhaustive real-save inspection; value_flow (wealth candidate) rejected on distribution grounds (median 1.78, max ~2 trillion)
decisions.rejected: Approximating from prosperity/possible_tax, or spreading province/country-level figures across member locations

decisions.decision: Tax Base uses possible_tax, not tax
decisions.why: possible_tax is the fiscal-base concept (potential before reductions); tax is current collected revenue
Matches how Location Population already shades by a raw headcount, not a ratio; population_ratio was the other candidate

decisions.decision: Primary Culture/Religion resolve via two new tables (cultures, religions) sourced from culture_manager/religion_manager, using the saves own colors
decisions.why: locations.culture/religion are bare numeric ids with no existing name lookup anywhere in the schema; the saves own manager sections carry both name and color per id
decisions.rejected: Reading culture/religion from static location_templates.txt (that is default/historical, not current save state)

decisions.decision: Location Terrain is generated static reference data (tools/map-generation/generate-terrain-lookup.ts writing src/components/Overview/locationTerrain.ts), not save-parsed or baked into the topojson asset
decisions.why: Terrain never appears in the save; it only exists in the games location_templates.txt install file, same kind of data rgoGameColors.ts already covers under the constitutions Encyclopedia-data exception
decisions.rejected: Baking topography into public/map/locations.topojson (feature 003 asset); reading location_templates.txt at runtime (no local filesystem access in a browser app)

decisions.decision: Location Market reads locations.market directly, no membership-list join
decisions.why: The location record already carries market=<idx> directly, confirmed in the real save
decisions.rejected: Normalizing markets member-location list into a join table (the original, more complex plan)

decisions.decision: Location Rank reads locations.rank, not original_rank
decisions.why: rank is the locations current settlement tier; original_rank is a historical snapshot

decisions.decision: Gave each numeric layer its own low/high gradient color pair (amber for Development, green for Tax Base, red for Soldiers) instead of reusing Populations blue
decisions.why: Only one layer is active at a time, but distinct gradients help a user recognize which of 12 layers is active at a glance (spec SC-004)
decisions.rejected: Reusing Populations exact blue gradient for every numeric layer

decisions.decision: Location Market tooltip/legend shows "Market <idx>" rather than a resolved display name
decisions.why: MapLocationRow only carries marketIdx, not a joined display name; matches the markets querys own COALESCE(...,  Market  || idx) fallback convention elsewhere in this codebase
decisions.rejected: Joining to a resolved market display name in listMapLocationsArrow, which would have added another join for a label already available in queries.ts elsewhere
